versions.changelog:
Initial release of YunZhi SEO Audit (云指建站SEO优化助手):

- Provides a full website SEO audit and optimization pipeline with per-dimension analysis (keywords, Title, Description, Heading, URL, internal links, Schema, indexability, page).
- Automatically generates an actionable optimization plan based on risk grading and applies low-risk fixes; high-risk changes require user confirmation.
- Includes a zero-dependency Python crawler/analysis script, outputting structured reports and risk-graded suggestions.
- Supports both standard websites (direct crawling) and MCP-based CMS platforms (safe offline analysis with strict credential handling and writeback constraints).
- Ensures compliance with SEO best practices, safety protocols, data integrity, and explicit user confirmations for sensitive actions.
